jobs.company: Legend Premium Real Estate Brokerage LLC
jobs.title: Fund Operations & Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
About Legend:

Legend Premium Real Estate Brokerage LLC is a luxury real estate brokerage based in Dubai, operating at the intersection of high-end property and investment. We work with high-net-worth clients and institutional investors to source, present, and close premium real estate opportunities across the UAE.
We are now expanding into financial markets, establishing a hedge fund that will operate alongside our real estate business, creating a fully integrated investment platform for our clients. This is an exciting period of growth, and we're building the team to match our ambitions.

About the role:

We're looking for a sharp, highly organised Fund Operations & Investment Analyst to be the operational backbone of the business. You'll support our traders with research and analysis, produce professional investor documents and presentations for both the fund and real estate divisions, and help execute on the company's strategic goals, all while keeping the office running smoothly.

Responsibilities:

Trading support & financial research
Assist traders with market research, financial analysis, and data gathering to support live trading decisions and fund reporting.
Investor documents & pitch decks
Produce investor memos, pitch decks, fund documents, and real estate presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, and AI tools. Output must be professional and client-ready.
Meetings & stakeholder coordination
Manage and coordinate meetings with investors, real estate brokers, and agents — including preparation materials, scheduling, follow-ups, and action tracking.
Execution & goal tracking
Support the execution of business decisions and short-term goals across the hedge fund and real estate divisions, ensuring deliverables are completed on time.
Office operations & performance
Manage the day-to-day running of the office, improve internal systems and processes, and contribute to the overall performance of the team.

Requirements:

Background in finance, business administration, or a related field
Advanced Excel skills — financial models, data analysis, and reporting
Proficient with AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to research, draft, and refine professional documents
Strong PowerPoint skills — able to build polished, investor-facing pitch decks and presentations
Excellent written and verbal English communication
Highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
Prior experience in a finance, investment, or real estate environmentProactive, fast-moving, and comfortable working in a lean, entrepreneurial team

What you'll get

Direct exposure to both luxury real estate and hedge fund operations in world's highest office space in Burj Khalif, 149 Floor. You'll work closely with senior leadership, have real ownership of your role, and grow with the business as we scale across both divisions.

Employment type

Industries
